interpretation_policy.binary_applicability: A literal can, may, does, do, is, are, must, whether, or related binary alternative asks its qualitative applicability/eligibility unless it also explicitly asks a procedure, amount or concrete outcome.
interpretation_policy.separate_clauses: Read the whole actual question, preserving any separately asked sequence, amount, destination, calculation or exception. Do not automatically delete true consequences that another clause actually requests.
interpretation_policy.no_extra_completeness: A correct explanation may give more than asked. That does not make every word or number in the explanation a separate completeness obligation.
interpretation_policy.conditional_accuracy: Keep conditions needed for a correct requested count/outcome. Incorporating normal rules may express the qualification; no special phrasing is required. Never assert two guaranteed successful moves after a unit has already left play.
interpretation_policy.truth_of_context: A volunteered materially false claim, including an unasked numerical amount or destination, still makes the whole answer Incorrect. True unasked context is not permission for wrong context.
interpretation_policy.lookup_support: Complete same-entry operative quotations may supply lookup facts without separate paraphrase, but concrete requested calculations still need actual values.
interpretation_policy.uncertainty: No missing movement layout, ownership or quantity is filled in. This report relies only on fixed supplied facts and literal words, without independently certifying source truth.
